title: Administrative fee

rate.doc: Fee as a fraction of reported net sales.

report_clause.doc: Name of the Sales-Reporting clause whose reports form the base.

due.doc: Time after each period's end by which the fee is due.

rounding.doc: Rounding applied to each period's fee.

UP:Admin-Fee/paid.doc: The payer attests payment of the fee for the period. Discharges the duty when acknowledged by the payee.

render: For each period of {{period|period}}, {{payer|role}} pays {{payee|role}} an administrative fee equal to {{rate|rate}} of the net sales reported for that period, rounded {{rounding|rounding}}, within {{due|period}} after the period ends. The fee is fixed at that rate for the term of this Agreement unless the Agreement is amended.
